topic: World-pinned stance contact locking and bipedal gait inverse kinematics
topic_zh: 世界坐标支撑相接触锁定与双足步态逆运动学
scope: Deterministic world-space stance contact pinning, two-link leg IK conformance and Node CPU solving. No StepControl or ARDY diffusion execution, friction dynamics or humanoid balance certification.

checks.name: solver-equivalence-128
checks.detail: 128 analytic and 40-step biped poses agree within 1e-10 scene units

checks.name: solver-equivalence-1024
checks.detail: 1024 analytic and 40-step biped poses agree within 1e-10 scene units

checks.name: solver-equivalence-8192
checks.detail: 8192 analytic and 40-step biped poses agree within 1e-10 scene units

checks.name: stance-zero-slip
checks.detail: 81 sampled gait frames retain 0.000000 world-space stance slip (max 1.78e-15)

checks.name: unpinned-skating-exposed
checks.detail: unpinned root-cycle baseline drifts by 0.2452 scene units at 0.2s

checks.name: planted-matrix-pinned
checks.detail: rendered left ankle world matrix stays pinned at the same ground coordinate across stance

checks.name: fixed-segment-lengths
checks.detail: thigh and shank segments preserve exact 1.45 / 1.35 lengths without stretching

checks.name: exact-reverse-matrix
checks.detail: reverse timestamp visitation reproduces the exact ankle world matrix

checks.name: atomic-gait-rejection
checks.detail: out-of-range stride is rejected while valid gait state remains intact

checks.name: geometry-matrix-conformance
checks.detail: hierarchical rendered ankle matrix matches independent two-link IK coordinates

checks.name: mobile-layout
checks.detail: 390px stance rig controls fit without horizontal overflow

checks.name: reduced-motion
checks.detail: reduced motion starts still and manual stance inspection remains available

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Two-leg analytic geometry versus 40-step knee angle bisection, not neural motion diffusion or browser rendering.

protocol.function: contact schedule → world ground anchor pin → hip-to-anchor vector → 2-link leg IK → zero-slip hierarchy

robustness.name: Sampled gait poses keep zero stance slip under reverse visitation

good_fit: Eliminating foot skating in procedural walk cycles
Fixed-length bipedal gantry and mech animation
Separating world-anchor pinning from learned style
not_for: StepControl or ARDY neural diffusion inference
Bipedal robot torque and balance control
